attribution.note: Zitron states these estimates and financing claims in his own voice.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the figures, favorable-scenario qualifier, concentration threshold and exclusive financing dependence.

contract.note: The spending and operating-capacity readings are ordinary and fair. The supplied Q2 reference period and interpretation of venture financing affect what evidence qualifies; neither is explicit in the statement.

evidence.note: Provides the earlier announced-capacity figure, but not a Q2 planning inventory or evidence of spending requirements, demand or financing dependence.
Distinguishes planned, construction and operational capacity, cautioning against treating the headline total as entirely planned. Its early-2026 inventory does not settle the Q2 claim.
The tentative 2025 physical-compute share concerns a different period and metric from annual customer spending. It cannot directly refute the claimed spending concentration.

reviews.rationale: The packet lacks a reproducible capacity-to-spending model, comparable demand and concentration estimates, and financing records establishing exclusive venture dependence. The capacity breakdown and physical-compute estimates raise relevant questions but do not settle the stated spending claims.
